_comment: Provenance for model_repo_coros_4_0_1.bin: the identifying fields of the
Version reply from the unit that produced it. The payload itself states
nothing about its own origin, so without this file nothing can tell which
firmware generated the snapshot beside it.
The serial number, MAC address and custom name are left out on purpose:
they identify one owner's unit and say nothing about the firmware, and
comms_version is left out for a different reason. It is a protocol version
and not an identity, and being a bytes field it has no faithful JSON
payload_sha256_note: Identifies THIS capture only. Each read rotates the per-model blob tokens, so a later read of the same catalog has a different hash. Compare parsed catalogs, never this value.
